```plato

    // The rotor of a plane rotation: R = cos(a/2) + sin(a/2) e12.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rotor_(mathematics)
    Rotor2D(r: Rotation2D): Rotor2D {
        var h = r.Angle * 0.5;
        return (h.Cos, h.Sin);
    }
```
